signal: Waymark raised an additional $42M (including CVS Health Ventures) to scale its tech-enabled, community-based Medicaid care, with its Signal ML tool predicting risk at 90%+ accuracy

email.body1:
Jenn, saw Waymark raised the additional $42M, with CVS Health Ventures in, to scale community-based Medicaid care.

Growth that fast usually means more provider and payer accounts in play than the team can cover before the new capacity ramps, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Waymark off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jenn, quick follow-up for Waymark.

Post-raise, revenue and coverage expectations usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Waymark needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jenn, last bit of proof for Waymark.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Waymark's reply rate likely compares to other healthcare teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jenn, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and the stretch right after a raise is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a value-based care motion? I will tailor it to Waymark either way.
